title: appendSeries
body:
## appendSeries

Append batches of sample rows to an unlimited chunked dataset in single-writer/multiple-reader (SWMR) mode while concurrent reader processes observe each flushed batch, for live acquisition and monitoring.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Files are written with libver latest (HDF5 1.10+ readers); structure cannot change after SWMR starts.
- Every reader observation must equal the independently computed flushed prefix.

Native binding: `h5py.File(libver=latest).swmr_mode / Dataset.resize / flush; concurrent reader File(swmr=True) / refresh`. Output kind: `["file","text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.
